content:
Chapter 617 - 617 On The Island; Humans Are Worse Than Dogs!

Chapter 617 - 617 On the Island; Humans Are Worse Than Dogs!

617 On the Island; Humans Are Worse Than Dogs!

Abraham was not the only one who was worried.

All the heroes of the various countries revealed a hint of fear on their faces.

However, no matter how they felt, they could not stop the countdown from continuing.

[3!]

[2!]

[1!]

In the next moment…

Lin Fan, Sam, Abraham, the Heavenly Hound… All the heroes of the various countries disappeared on the spot.

Then, they appeared on a strange rocky island.

The island was only about the size of a few football fields, and it was surrounded by endless blue sea water.

The rolling waves kept hitting the rocks, making a dull sound.

The heroes of the various countries stood on the island and looked around. They looked at each other… They were at a loss.

Soon, someone began to talk in a low voice.

“Hello, are you from Earth?”

“I’m Shi Titian from Song Country.”

“I’m Irvanya from the State of Na.”

…

Meeting an Earthling in another world was like meeting a fellow countryman.

However, everyone was not as excited as they usually were.

On the contrary, they still had some precautions.

They understood that the Otherworld was very dangerous.

The humans in the Otherworld might be even more dangerous.

Some people had formed grudges in the Otherworld.

“It’s you!” A fair-skinned man shouted.

As soon as he finished speaking, he clenched his fist and smashed it at the brown-skinned man not far away.

The brown-skinned man was not afraid at all and went up to meet him head-on.

They had all opened treasure chests and obtained great strength. They were like ferocious beasts, incomparably powerful.

Not long after, bloodstains appeared on their bodies. They were extremely miserable.

This was not the only instance of it.

It was normal for such a situation to occur.

After all, everyone had limited supplies.

And the Otherworld lacked resources. In order to survive, they could only fight for it from others.

In fact, Lin Fan had faced numerous assassination attempts because of resources.

However, the other parties were instantly killed.

After a while, the few of them lay on the ground, unable to get up.

The island finally regained its peace.

Everyone subconsciously distanced themselves from the people around them to avoid danger.

Regarding these…

Lin Fan did not care about any of them.

He only glanced at everyone indifferently.

57 people.

In other words, there were only 57 people left…

One had to know…

There were 200 countries in the world, and each country had at least one person selected.

For big countries like Nashland, Bear Country, and Eagle Country, the number of people chosen was usually several, and there were even more than ten!

In other words, more than half of them had died in just over a month.

It was tragic.

Abraham quickly ran to Lin Fan. Beside him was a woman with a high nose.

Although the woman’s body was tattered and she was in an extremely sorry state, just from her face and figure, it was not difficult to tell that she was definitely a beauty.

“This is Mordmohan,” Abraham introduced.

“This is Lin Fan from Hua Nation. He’s very powerful!”

At this point, Abraham’s tone could not help but become high and worshipful.

Mordmohan was surprised.

She knew Abraham’s personality.

He was a very confident and self-reliant man.

He actually worshipped another man?

This… It was unbelievable.

Mordmohan sized Lin Fan up before extending her right hand and speaking in a somewhat stiff Hua language. “Hello, I am Mordmohan.”

Lin Fan smiled and nodded. “Hello, I’m Lin Fan.”

Then, he reached out his right hand and shook it gently.

At this moment, someone whispered, “This island seems to be full of rocks. There aren’t even any trees. How are we going to live?”

As soon as he said that, everyone could not help but pull away from the people around them.

If there was no food, then the little food they had might make them the prey of others.

While they were on guard, time slowly passed.

As the sun set, it dyed the sky and the sea red, forming a picture of a demon from hell.

It was incomparably ferocious and terrifying!

The atmosphere was extremely gloomy.

Lin Fan, on the other hand, was extremely relaxed.

He found a random rock and sat down.

At this moment, a large bird flapped its wings and flew across the sky.

In the next moment, the giant bird felt as if a huge mountain was pressing down on it. It fell straight down.

“Pa!”

Lin Fan picked up the bird and took out a knife to remove its feathers.

Then, he applied all kinds of seasonings.

Then, the big bird’s body automatically burst into flames.

After a while, a rich fragrance filled the entire island.

The heroes of the various countries all turned their gazes over.

They looked at the roasted meat that was dripping with oil and could not help but swallow their saliva.

Some of them even had red eyes.

They had already been in the Otherworld for more than a month.

The food that they had brought with them had already been eaten up after entering the Otherworld for a few days.

Later on, some people were lucky enough to encounter wild fruits and weeds, which allowed them to survive.

Some people did not even encounter wild fruits or weeds. They had been living on tree bark and roots.

As for barbecued meat… They could only dream of such delicious roasted meat.

But now, it had appeared before their eyes.

How could they not be excited?

Lin Fan did not care much. He tore off three pieces of meat and handed them to Sam, Abraham, and Mordmohan.

Sam and Abraham did not hesitate at all and started eating.

Mordmohan was puzzled. “This… You actually brought seasonings?”

“Mr. Lin is omnipotent!” Abraham said. “Hurry up and eat. It won’t taste good if it gets cold.”

Mordmohan also put the meat into her mouth and ate happily.

At this moment, a fair-skinned man slowly walked over and said in English, “Give me something to eat too.”

He was not discussing it at all. It was a statement, an affirmation, and an order!

In fact, he almost took the meat with his own hands.

“Scram!” Lin Fan said indifferently.

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan tore off a thick thigh and handed it to the Heavenly Hound.

The Heavenly Hound wagged its tail and ate the meat happily.

The man’s expression instantly turned extremely ugly.

Lin Fan would rather give it to a dog than himself.

Was he saying that he was worse than a dog?

“F*ck!” the man said coldly.

As soon as he finished speaking, he reached out to snatch the roasted meat.

Lin Fan’s face was cold as he shouted, “Scram!”

A terrifying aura suddenly erupted.

The man seemed to have hit an invisible truck. He flew backward and crashed into a pile of rocks in the distance. Blood flowed everywhere, and he could not get up.
